activity_summary: On the second walk to Finsbury you did not try a name aloud. You saw a horse and did not buy it. You said the list stays whole, and you turned for home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Walked the second turn, refused the names, and started home.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: No names. The mouth does not get a speech out of a walk.
